root_authority.identity: FILE_ID_INFO volume serial plus 128-bit file ID, stable before and after verification
root_authority.security: protected current-user-only owner and DACL required
root_authority.volume: fixed non-hotplug local NTFS with persistent ACLs

manifest.identity: SHA-256 of exact bounded compiled-in manifest bytes
manifest.entries: strictly sorted finite allowlist of canonical relative file paths, sizes, SHA-256 digests, and signer policies
manifest.duplicates: reject exact, ordinal-case-insensitive, and normalized component collisions
manifest.model: external and excluded; no model path, size, digest, or handle is accepted by this verifier

tree_walk.descendants: one safe UTF-16 component per NtOpenFile RootDirectory open
tree_walk.inventory: enumerate every reachable object beneath expected directories and require exact derived directory plus manifest file set

file_verification.read: retained handle only, exact bounded size, no content returned
file_verification.digest: SHA-256 over every allowlisted file with before/after identity and size rechecks
file_verification.signatures: EXE, DLL, and script entries require a future handle-bound offline Authenticode policy hook and exact signer-subject digest
file_verification.deadline: future cancellable native-I/O boundary must check cancellation and monotonic deadline before and after every blocking boundary

receipt.canonical: fixed key order compact ASCII JSON
receipt.success_requires: all entries, directories, hashes, identities, signer policies, root identity, and exact inventory verified
